guitar.notes: Dimebag Darrell's Dean ML "Dean from Hell" and later Washburn Dime signature are iconic and well documented; entry accurate.

tone.target: tight Dimebag-style high-gain rhythm with scooped mids and sharp pick attack
tone.profile: tight Dimebag-style high-gain rhythm with scooped mids and sharp pick attack
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain using a modern solid-state amp model (Recti) combined with heavy distortion and scooped EQ for maximum tightness and aggression.
corrections: add scooped EQ and pick attack

rig.name: Pantera - Mouth For War (D standard) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain rhythm playing.
Provide a slight boost for increased pick attack and presence.
blocks.gap: No dedicated 'pick attack' module, using Boost to simulate transient enhancement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core heavy distortion and saturation required for Pantera's sound.

alternatives.model: RAT-style (if more aggressive grit is needed)

blocks.purpose: Simulate a modern, high-output solid-state amp suitable for tight metal rhythm.

alternatives.model: UK 800 (if slightly more vintage grit is desired)

blocks.purpose: Provide a modern, aggressive sounding cabinet suitable for heavy rhythm.
blocks.gap: While UK Vintage 4x12 is classic, Mess 4x12 offers a more contemporary/aggressive voicing needed for the genre.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the required scooped mids and overall tight EQ profile.
No modulation effects are needed; keeping the tone dry and aggressive.
Add minimal, subtle ambience to prevent the tone from sounding too sterile.
blocks.gap: The verdict specified 'keep it dry,' so this is a very low-mix addition for depth rather than a primary effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal amount of natural room ambience without muddying the tight rhythm.
blocks.gap: Keeping reverb very low to maintain tightness, fulfilling the 'dry' requirement while adding dimension.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the aggressive, modern sound of Pantera's rhythm guitar.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, modern bite needed for Dimebag's tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the low end.
